In the earlier days of the brand, Rhone began hosting an event series called Mind & Muscle that gathered men for workout sessions in Rhone stores, followed by what was “essentially group therapy,” Checketts said. More than 1,000 people have participated over the years, he said, and the company has hosted more than 50 Mind & Muscle events so far in 2024. Rhone now intends to include women in the series, which features upcoming events tied to the NBA and LPGA partnerships.
